name: god-of-sessions
description: A local-first Electron home for Morrow conversations and provider-neutral Overnight work.
author: tumblecat44

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.dogfood:electron:portfolio: npm run build && node .grok/skills/verify-god-of-sessions/scripts/drive.mjs overnight-board && node .grok/skills/verify-god-of-sessions/scripts/drive.mjs kanban-tickets
scripts.verify:ui: node .grok/skills/verify-god-of-sessions/scripts/drive.mjs tonight-home && node .grok/skills/verify-god-of-sessions/scripts/drive.mjs overnight-board && node .grok/skills/verify-god-of-sessions/scripts/drive.mjs settings-clis && node .grok/skills/verify-god-of-sessions/scripts/drive.mjs four-routes
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir
scripts.landing:deploy: npm run landing:build && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply god-of-sessions-metrics --remote && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run landing:test
